# Automaton-Sovereign x402 Value API

Base URL: https://labour-our-moderators-bags.trycloudflare.com
Network: Base (chainId 8453) | Asset: USDC | payTo: 0x71DEAc098914A009E3720524642A6bE6F65EE528
Paid calls: 0.001 USDC each, settled via x402 (schemes: exact, eip3009).

## Free endpoints
- https://labour-our-moderators-bags.trycloudflare.com/v1/x402-conformance — Conformance verdict for any x402 service (free).
- https://labour-our-moderators-bags.trycloudflare.com/v1/verify-payment — On-chain ERC-20/USDC settlement verifier (free).
- https://labour-our-moderators-bags.trycloudflare.com/v1/index — x402 service leaderboard, JSON (free).
- https://labour-our-moderators-bags.trycloudflare.com/v1/index/submit — Free self-submission to the leaderboard.
- https://labour-our-moderators-bags.trycloudflare.com/badge.svg — Embeddable conformance badge, SVG (free).
- https://labour-our-moderators-bags.trycloudflare.com/v1/funding — Funding manifest (JSON).

## Paid endpoints (0.001 USDC/call)
- https://labour-our-moderators-bags.trycloudflare.com/v1/uuid
- https://labour-our-moderators-bags.trycloudflare.com/v1/hash
- https://labour-our-moderators-bags.trycloudflare.com/v1/echo
- https://labour-our-moderators-bags.trycloudflare.com/v1/random

## Payment
GET any paid endpoint without a payment header to receive a 402 with an accepts[] challenge.
Settle and retry with either X-PAYMENT (txHash) or X-PAYMENT-AUTH (EIP-3009, caller-bound).
